name: Liz Peterson
office: Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Liz Peterson is a parent and business owner running for the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District board. She is an appointed member of the Rancho Palos Verdes Emergency Preparedness Committee, and her campaign says she has volunteered with district schools and parent-teacher groups since 2011.

sentences.text: Liz Peterson is a parent and business owner running for the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District board.
She is an appointed member of the Rancho Palos Verdes Emergency Preparedness Committee, and her campaign says she has volunteered with district schools and parent-teacher groups since 2011.

items.text: Her campaign lists transparent decisions, responsible budgeting, and school safety as main goals, and says she supports higher pay for teachers and staff. In an interview, Peterson said the district should rethink how it provides mental health programs and that bond funds should prioritize needs like air conditioning, lighting, and safety. She said closing schools would be a last option and that the district needs a social media policy restricting employees from posting information on students' identities.
